checked_classes: ordering errors — the slices run S1 contract/ownership before S2 runtime wiring, S3 approvals after/alongside the frozen contract, S4 recovery/settings after runtime and bridge wiring, S5 packaging configuration after production wiring, and S6 builds/gate/publication after freeze; no dependency is scheduled after its consumer

missing dependencies — each stated goal is covered by a slice or gate: worktree reconciliation in S1, envelope/isolation/approvals/AG-UI/recovery/startup in S2–S4, packaging and native assets in S5, installed gate/publication in S6, and outcome ledger in the completion section

untestable or ambiguous acceptance criteria — the P1 gate uses observable installed behaviors, named scenarios, pass/fail/pending evidence, exact artifact/version/checksum validation, and explicit blocking failures rather than generic 'works correctly' criteria

scope smuggling — P2–P5 capabilities are explicitly deferred or isolated, while P1 scope maps to OpenSpec tasks 1.1–1.10 and the assessment findings; website/GitHub release updates are within the stated goals

constraint violations — the plan remains planning-only for this turn, reuses the existing OpenSpec change/tasks, requires complete P1 wiring before builds/gates, avoids per-edit/unit/review loops, orders Windows x64 before Apple Silicon, uses GitHub Releases rather than IPFS, and permits only one isolated successor overlap after freeze
